name: Godot Prompter
description: Agentic skills framework for Godot 4.x game development — 41 domain-specific skills that give AI coding agents deep expertise in GDScript and C#. Covers the full development lifecycle: project setup, architecture patterns, player controllers, animation, shaders, particles, audio, physics, 2D/3D rendering, UI, multiplayer, save/load, and deployment. Each skill provides tested code examples, comparison tables, common pitfalls, and implementation checklists. Includes 3 specialized agents for game architecture, implementation, and code review.
longDescription:
Ships **55 skills**, **9 agents** and **1 hook**.

- **Skills** (55): `2d-essentials` (Use when working with 2D-specific systems — TileMaps, parallax scrolling, 2D lights and shadows, canvas layers, particles 2D,…), `3d-essentials` (Use when working with 3D-specific systems — materials, lighting, shadows, environment, global illumination, fog, LOD, occlusion culling, and…), `ability-system` (Use when building character abilities — Resource-based abilities with cost/cooldown/cast, buffs/debuffs, stat modifiers, gameplay tags, and HUD binding), `addon-development` (Use when creating Godot editor plugins — EditorPlugin, @tool scripts, custom inspectors, and dock panels), `ai-navigation` (Use when implementing AI movement — NavigationAgent2D/3D, steering behaviors, behavior trees, and patrol patterns), `animation-system` (Use when implementing animations — AnimationPlayer, AnimationTree, blend trees, state machines, sprite animation, and code-driven animation), `assets-pipeline` (Use when importing and managing assets — image compression, 3D scene import, audio formats, resource formats, and import…), `audio-system` (Use when implementing audio — audio buses, AudioStreamPlayer, spatial audio, music management, SFX pooling, and dynamic mixing), and 47 more
- **Agents** (9): `godot-animator` (Use this agent when the user needs to design or implement animation systems in Godot 4.x — AnimationPlayer…), `godot-code-reviewer` (Use this agent when the user wants their Godot GDScript or C# code reviewed for best practices, anti-patterns,…), `godot-csharp-engineer` (Use this agent for C#-first Godot 4.x development — writing idiomatic C# (not GDScript translations), managing GC pressure…), `godot-game-architect` (Use this agent when the user needs help with Godot 4.x game development architecture, GDScript or C# system…), `godot-game-dev` (Use this agent when the user needs help implementing Godot Engine features, including GDScript or C# coding, scene/node…), `godot-performance-profiler` (Use this agent when the user reports lag, stutter, frame drops, draw call spikes, GC pauses (C#), physics…), `godot-shader-author` (Use this agent when the user needs to write a custom Godot shader, post-processing effect, screen-space effect, custom…), `godot-tools-engineer` (Use this agent for Godot 4.x editor-side tooling — EditorPlugin, EditorInspectorPlugin, EditorImportPlugin, custom inspectors, EditorNode3DGizmoPlugin, dock panels, @tool…), and 1 more
- **Hooks** (1): `SessionStart`

Installs with `claude plugin install godot-prompter@claude-community` from `jame581/GodotPrompter`.
